body:
Keep the exact same expressive semi-realistic natural history illustration of a square-faced Tibetan fox with its iconic wide boxy head, sandy-ochre fur, and utterly deadpan half-closed unimpressed eyes. Comedy contrast: the fox's giant square face and deadpan unblinking eyes remain 100% motionless across all frames, while its two front paws slowly clap together. Floating cleanly in the air ABOVE the head (with a wide empty transparent gap between the sign and the ears, NO sticks, NO poles), a flat rectangular white label with a crisp black border and bold black Chinese text reads '好棒棒'. Isolated on a pure transparent background. Strictly NO white sticker border, NO white outline. Smooth 9-frame looping animation.

Production adaptation: The text above defines the visual idea and action. For this call output only ONE PNG SPRITE SHEET, NOT a GIF file: exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, 9 equal square cells, chronological row-major order. No border, grid lines, gutters, frame numbers, timestamps, or extra text. Fixed camera and ground line unless the action explicitly moves the camera. Keep scale, character identity, palette and geometry consistent; each cell is one distinctly different consecutive animation pose with nothing crossing cell boundaries. Cells will be extracted and encoded locally afterward. Make the motion return naturally from the final cell to the first.
The exact floating text in every cell is '好棒棒'. Nine poses show the front paws slowly approaching, touching, separating, and returning. Keep the fox face and half-closed eyes absolutely unchanged. Preserve true transparent pixels, including the gap under the floating sign.

en.description: 9 frames, 1.8 seconds, 415×420px; repeats indefinitely. GPT Image frame-sheet + local GIF encoding.
en.body:
## How to use

Upload the 1 project-generated reference image(s) in the displayed order (R10), then use the complete adapted prompt.

Generate one PNG sheet, extract 9 cells in row-major order, and encode them with the recorded delays and loop setting. The GIF is composed locally; the image tool returned a still PNG. The source sheet, exact crops, frame delays and first-frame poster are retained in the campaign archive.

## Result and limitations

9 frames, 1.8 seconds, 415×420px; repeats indefinitely. GPT Image frame-sheet + local GIF encoding.

Nine actual transparent GIF frames show front paws clapping while half-closed deadpan eyes remain stable. All labels correctly read 好棒棒 and float above the ears without supports. Inspected encoded GIF against light and dark backgrounds: real alpha and no white outline. Slight face redraw variation remains; 100-percent pixel locking is not claimed.

## Source

Adapted by Prompt Seen from [@vastxie's original prompt](https://x.com/vastxie/status/2118586752915095805). The author labels the source work Image 2.6; this run only establishes the GPT Image family, with no exact model ID. The prompt preserves its submitted language on both page editions. Likes describe the whole source post, shared by variants, and are not engagement for this example.

## 使用方法

先生成单张 PNG 精灵图，按行优先提取 9 格，以记录的停留时长和循环设置编码为 GIF。生图工具返回静态 PNG；GIF 由本地合成。原精灵图、裁切坐标、逐帧时长与首帧封面均保存在批次档案。

## 结果与限制

9 帧，1.8 秒，415×420 像素，无限循环；GPT Image 精灵图逐格裁切并在本地编码为 GIF。

9 帧保留真实透明背景，前爪鼓掌，悬浮字牌“好棒棒”正确。深浅背景检查未见白边；脸部仍有轻微重绘差异，不能视为逐像素锁定。
